{{Quote|Not everything is black and white.|Part of an advertisement for the Church|<ref name="HoloNet Ad">{{HoloNetNewsAd|url=meta/img/ads/468_9.gif|text=Church of Toydaria}}</ref>}}
The '''Church of Toydaria''' was a religious group<ref name="HoloNet Ad" /> that had a presence on the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Toydaria/Legends|Toydaria]].<ref name="LoNH" /> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="Date">The advert can appear on any of the [[HoloNet News (original website)|Holonet News]] articles that range from {{HoloNetNewsWeb|45||HoloNet News Vol. 531 #45}} to {{HoloNetNewsWeb|56||HoloNet News Vol. 531 #56}}. These articles date themselves to 13:2:28 [[Great ReSynchronization|G.R.S.]] and 13.5.15 G.R.S respectively, corresponds to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] according to the reasoning [[Template:YearMathGRS|here]].</ref> the church was advertised on [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]] that postulated, "Why? Why Not?" and claimed that the church welcomed all.<ref name="HoloNet Ad" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:ChurchofToydaria.gif|thumb|right|300px|Church of Toydaria advertisement]]
The Church of Toydaria was first mentioned in an advertisement<ref name="HoloNet Ad" /> on the [[HoloNet News (original website)|''HoloNet News'' website]]<ref name="HoloNet News">[[HoloNet News (original website)|''HoloNet News'' website]].</ref> written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and [[Paul Ens]].<ref name="HNN Credits">{{HoloNetNewsWeb||credits.html|Credits}}</ref> [[HoloNet News Vol. 531 45|''HoloNet News Vol. 531'' #45]], the first set of articles,<ref name="HNN45">{{Hnn|45||HoloNet News Vol. 531 #45}}</ref> was published to the ''HoloNet News'' website on [[February 28]], [[2002]].<ref name="HNN45 date">Per {{JCFCite|url=posts/6042498|board=Literature|thread=The Official HoloNetNews Discussion Thread|user=IAmTheDarkSide|date=2002-03-14|time=5:40 PM|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20220914072556/https://boards.theforce.net/threads/the-official-holonetnews-discussion-thread.5990764/page-4#post-6042498}}, [[HoloNet News Vol. 531 47|''HoloNet News Vol. 531'' #47]] was released on [[March 14]], [[2002]]. As [[HoloNet News (original website)|HoloNet News]] segments were published weekly, and {{Hnn|45||A Closer Look}} was published two issues prior, it must have been released on [[February 28]] of the same year.</ref>
